signals.name: maxDepth
signals.quantity: maximum recursion depth of NotifierState.notifyDone chain walk during one execution
signals.storage: ThreadLocal<long[]> in RecursionCounters.NOTIFY_DEPTH; [0]=current depth, [1]=max depth this execution
signals.reset: V1Guidance.getInput() calls RecursionCounters.resetNotify() before returning the input stream

plans.retention: Primary: retain input if maxDepth > bestMaxDepth (hill-climb recursion depth toward stack overflow). Secondary (flat signal): when maxDepth is zero or unchanged, retain inputs with greater length (up to MAX_INPUT_SIZE) to grow toward the 5000-byte threshold where ~2500 registrations trigger overflow. Inputs are prioritized by maxDepth first, then by length.
mutation: Byte-level: bit flips (1-3 bits), byte replacement (random value), chunk insert (1-16 random bytes), chunk delete (1-16 bytes)

Repetition [R45(a)]: full-input doubling (append copy of entire input) and chunk-repeat (copy random slice k times, k up to MAX_INPUT_SIZE / slice.length). From 8-byte seed, ~10 doublings reach 8192 bytes in <1 second at 100 exec/sec. Selected ~15% of mutations.

Dictionary [R45(b)]: tokens from attack path code — {(byte)0xFF} (all-bits-set registration byte), {(byte)0x80} (minimum registration byte, threshold of isRegistrationByte), {(byte)0x00} (non-registration byte), {(byte)0x7F} (maximum non-registration byte). Inserted or overwritten at random positions. Selected ~15% of mutations.
No encoding operator needed [R45(c)] — input is raw bytes with no format checks or checksums.
